title: 记忆候选、确认、修改、删除与来源 API
completed: V12 migration service/platform/persistence/src/main/resources/db/migration/V12__memory_candidate_management_api.sql: two new SECURITY DEFINER functions (update_memory, list_memory_evidence) and CREATE OR REPLACE delete_memory. No table structure or privilege-revocation-set change; canonical confirmation gate untouched.

update_memory(owner, memory_id, summary): status-preserving content edit. SET clause is summary-only (never status); only PENDING_CONFIRMATION/ACCEPTED are editable; FOR UPDATE; blank/foreign/absent/deleted/dead-end all raise echoing only the caller's own values (existence hidden). Naturally idempotent (same summary twice succeeds both times, content stable).

list_memory_evidence(owner, memory_id): ordered source Evidence for an owned non-deleted memory. JOIN on memory_item with deleted_at IS NULL hides deleted-memory evidence; foreign/absent/deleted resolve to empty, indistinguishable from a real memory with no evidence, so existence is never disclosed. out_ prefix avoids PL/pgSQL variable shadowing.

delete_memory made idempotent to match the V11-documented 'Idempotent on already-deleted rows': a PERFORM ... FOR UPDATE existence check distinguishes owned (returns TRUE whether or not the soft-delete UPDATE touches rows) from foreign/absent (raises, existence hidden). Fixes the V11 doc/impl mismatch; cross-owner isolation unchanged (test 33 still passes). CREATE OR REPLACE preserves the V11 EXECUTE ACL.
Both new functions SECURITY DEFINER, SET search_path=vc,public, set_config('vc.owner_user_id') before any table access, REVOKE EXECUTE FROM PUBLIC + GRANT vc_api (TASK-0016 P0 class).

OpenAPI: 8 memory endpoints (createMemoryCandidate, listMemories, getMemory, updateMemory, deleteMemory, confirmMemoryCandidate, rejectMemoryCandidate, listMemoryEvidence) + Memory/MemoryCandidateCreateRequest/MemoryUpdateRequest/MemoryEvidence schemas + MemoryId parameter; reuses existing MEMORY_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED and MEMORY_FORBIDDEN_CONTENT error codes (zero catalog/generated change). list/evidence return empty not 404 (existence hidden); delete documented idempotent; confirm documented non-idempotent into canonical. openapi validate + drift PASS.

SQL tests 34 (re-delete now asserts idempotent TRUE), 35 (update + evidence + cross-owner/cross-relationship isolation), 36 (idempotency/duplicate-request semantics). Full suite 01-36 PASS in Docker pgvector. R1 PASS no P0/P1; canonical gate integrity, idempotency correctness, privilege hygiene, and OpenAPI-SQL consistency all independently verified.
remaining: Resume Backlog longline: next promotable TASK-0029 (deps include TASK-0028, satisfied).

Java CanonicalMemoryRepository/Service wiring these SECURITY DEFINER functions to the OpenAPI HTTP surface is a separate runtime-implementation card; the contract and SQL layer are complete and verified here.
knownRisks: P2: the negative test cases in tests 35/36 use the BEGIN/PERFORM/RAISE/EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS pattern, which cannot detect a removed guard (the test's own RAISE is caught by the same handler). The guards are independently verified correct and cross-owner has FORCE-RLS + explicit-owner-predicate defense-in-depth; this matches the V11 tests 32/33 ACCEPTED baseline. Regression-detection quality, not a present defect. Future hardening: convert to SQLSTATE/GET DIAGNOSTICS positive assertions.

P3: validation-class failures (blank summary, non-editable status) raise inside the functions, but the OpenAPI documents only 200/401/404 and the ErrorCode enum has no 400-class code. A future HTTP layer would map such a raise to NOT_FOUND_OR_FORBIDDEN (404), which is semantically imprecise. Out of scope for this card (no Java layer) and the card forbids adding catalog error codes; the functions fail closed (safe). Future card: add a VALIDATION_ERROR (400) catalog code or have the request schema reject blank summary (minLength: 1).

delete_memory now returns TRUE for the owner on an already-deleted memory (idempotent). This is owner-scoped same-data behavior; cross-owner delete still raises without disclosing existence (test 33).
